description: Opt-in C2HLS_PP_LOAD_B_IN_DF overlay. Keep-flash ping-pong but load_B is an INLINE-off DATAFLOW task inside the tile loop (B_local is a channel). Default keep-flash still loads B once outside. Do not mix into the flash 90-skill dump.

skills.pattern: keep-flash wrap stages full B once before the tile DATAFLOW (prefix ~331). That prefix cannot overlap compute. Putting LANES=16 load_B inside the tile DATAFLOW as its own INLINE-off task lets it share the issue slot with load_A_tile (gmem1 vs gmem0) while compute uses the B channel.
skills.strategy: Keep flash LANES=16 load_B body. Call it INSIDE `for (t < NT) { #pragma HLS DATAFLOW }`. Declare B_local inside that region (HLS channel). Keep A_buf[2]/C_buf[2] + t&1. Do not drop k0 += LANES. Do not fuse load_A and load_B.
required_steps: keep `const int LANES = 16` and k0 += LANES / UNROLL u on load_B
move load_B(B, B_local) into the tile DATAFLOW body
declare data_t B_local[J][K] inside the DATAFLOW loop (not a prefix RAM)
keep A_buf[2] / C_buf[2] (or C_pre[2]) indexed with t&1
do not scalar-walk B; do not emit mm_pe FIFOs
guards: B_local declared outside + load_B inside is HLS 200-976
load_B without LANES is the 4171 fail
DATAFLOW around one full-matrix load/compute/store is still 12893

skills.pattern: C2HLS_PP_LOAD_B_IN_DF is on but the wrap still does load_B(B, B_local) before the tile loop
skills.strategy: Move that call into the DATAFLOW tile body and declare B_local there. Keep the LANES=16 walk.
required_steps: move it next to load_A_tile under #pragma HLS DATAFLOW
guards: this overlay does not relax keep-flash latency cap flash x 1.10
